wasteland_and_barren_categories.category_name: Barren / Unculturable / Wastelands - Salt Affected Land
wasteland_and_barren_categories.description: Inland saline and alkaline flats common in the northern and western tracts of Ahmedabad district.
Upland terrain dominated by wild shrubs, thorny vegetation, and sparse topsoil coverage.
Barren sandy riverbeds and uncultivated tracts adjacent to the Sabarmati river basin.
